anomalies.observed: The flying capacitor across the SSD1306 charge-pump stage-1 pins C1P/C1N is drawn as 4.7 µF (C13).
anomalies.expected: The specification calls for a 1 µF capacitor across C1P/C1N (C12 in the spec). A 4.7 µF flying capacitor is an order-of-magnitude deviation from the intended charge-pump design.

evidence.quote: C12 (1 µF) — across U4 C1P/C1N (charge-pump stage 1 flying capacitor)
C13 4.7u connected between U3 C1P (pin 4) and C1N (pin 5)

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 charge pump is designed for a 1 µF flying capacitor; a 4.7 µF part changes the pump's switching behaviour and can prevent the panel bias rail from reaching its specified level, degrading or disabling the OLED display.

parsed.summary: The schematic largely matches the intended Portal design, but the SSD1306 charge-pump flying capacitor on C1P/C1N is drawn as 4.7 µF instead of the specified 1 µF, a value deviation that can affect the OLED bias supply.
